scientific_scope: Exact simple-continuous-null finite-sample CDF of the two-sided location-standardized Kolmogorov–Smirnov statistic; algebraic computation at rational thresholds for every integer sample size.
title: Exact algebraic finite-sample calibration of the two-sided argmax-standardized Kolmogorov–Smirnov statistic
